commands.author: sunlit-deng

target.title: feat: add disableBoundaryAwareCache compat option for prefix-matching prompt cache providers
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where DeepSeek OpenAI-compatible users could lose provider prompt-cache hits after the 6.x boundary-aware cache split put per-turn dynamic context into the system prompt.

Closes #94518

Related: #91018, #90583

## Why This Change Was Made

DeepSeek uses prefix-matching cache behavior, so its stable system prefix needs to remain byte-stable across turns. This PR adds `compat.disableBoundaryAwareCache`, defaults it on for DeepSeek, keeps only the stable prefix in the system message, and moves the dynamic suffix into the latest user turn so older conversation history stays reusable.

Xiaomi is kept opt-in — users can set `compat.disableBoundaryAwareCache: true` manually, but the automatic default is DeepSeek-only until Xiaomi-specific upstream cache-contract and live-behavior evidence exists.

Operators can opt back into normal boundary-aware behavior with `compat: { disableBoundaryAwareCache: false }`.

## User Impact

DeepSeek users should keep the stable system prompt and prior conversation history cacheable across multi-turn requests instead of invalidating the reusable prefix with each dynamic suffix update. Xiaomi users are unaffected by default.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.test.ts`: 41 passed
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/openai-transport-stream.test.ts`: 302 passed

Real production request-shape proof (imports the actual `buildOpenAICompletionsParams` production module):

```text
$ npx tsx deepseek-proof.ts
--- DeepSeek (disableBoundaryAwareCache: true) ---
system.content="You are helpful"
system.hasDynamicSuffix=true
msg1.role=user
msg1.content="Historical request"
msg2.role=assistant
lastUser.hasDynamicSuffix=true
lastUser.hasCurrentRequest=true

--- DeepSeek (disableBoundaryAwareCache: false) ---
system.content="You are helpful
Project Context"
lastUser.hasDynamicSuffix=true

--- GPT (boundary stripped, no split) ---
system.content="You are helpful
Project Context"
system.hasBoundary=false
lastUser.hasDynamicSuffix=false
```

<details>
<summary>deepseek-proof.ts</summary>

```ts
import { SYSTEM_PROMPT_CACHE_BOUNDARY } from "@openclaw/ai/internal/shared";
import { buildOpenAICompletionsParams } from "../../worktrees/pr-95311/src/agents/openai-transport-stream.js";
import type { Model } from "openclaw/plugin-sdk/llm";

function deepseekModel(): Model<"openai-completions"> {
  return {
    id: "deepseek-v4-pro", name: "DeepSeek V4 Pro",
    api: "openai-completions", provider: "deepseek",
    baseUrl: "https://api.deepseek.com",
    compat: { thinkingFormat: "deepseek" },
    reasoning: true, input: ["text"],
    cost: { input: 0, output: 0, cacheRead: 0, cacheWrite: 0 },
    contextWindow: 1_000_000, maxTokens: 384_000,
  };
}

function main() {
  const ds = buildOpenAICompletionsParams(deepseekModel(), {
    systemPrompt: `You are helpful${SYSTEM_PROMPT_CACHE_BOUNDARY}Project Context`,
    messages: [
      { role: "user", content: "Historical request", timestamp: 1 },
      { role: "assistant", content: "Historical answer", timestamp: 2 },
      { role: "user", content: "Current request", timestamp: 3 },
    ],
    tools: [],
  } as never, undefined);
  const msgs = (ds as any).messages;
  console.log("--- DeepSeek (disableBoundaryAwareCache: true) ---");
  console.log(`system.content="${msgs[0]?.content}"`);
  // ... full proof in outputs/issue-94518/deepseek-proof.ts
}

main();
```

</details>
